review: “In one-on-one duels, my Palermitan Style has the advantage”, the very thing Thumb Heathcliff’s kit is built around. Thumb Heathcliff is a Tremor and Burn ID whose kit revolves around heavily stacking his unique status on one target and well.. focus on them. When he does so, he gains massive buffs and becomes very consistent. Let’s take a deeper look at his kit! Firstly, his 3 unique statuses: - The Duel Escalates - This status revolves around Heathcliff’s entire kit, as it heavily interacts with his passive and skills. The main way to inflict it is when Thumb Heathcliff hits an enemy or wins a clash. Heathcliff can only inflict this up to 3 times per turn. - Maturing Textbook - A free damage boost up to a maximum of 15%. Gained when Thumb Heathcliff defeats an enemy with The Duel Escalates or after using S3-2. This effect can only be gained 2 times each turn and stacks up to 3. - Severe
